sources.content: Lanternwick is a Python library for building data pipelines. It supports Python 3.11 and 3.12. Set up a development environment with uv sync, then run tests with uv run pytest. Type checking uses mypy in strict mode, and linting uses ruff; both run in CI and must pass. The public API is whatever is exported from lanternwick/__init__.py, and anything with a leading underscore is private and may change without notice.

Lanternwick follows semantic versioning. Any change that removes or renames a public function needs a deprecation warning for at least two minor releases before removal. Record user-facing changes in a new file under changes/ named after the pull request number. Docs are built with MkDocs and published from the docs branch. Keep test fixtures smaller than 1 megabyte; larger sample data belongs in the separate lanternwick-data repository.

claims.text: Lanternwick type checks with mypy in strict mode.
Removing a public Lanternwick function requires a deprecation warning for at least one minor release.
Lanternwick docs are built with MkDocs.
Names with a leading underscore in Lanternwick are private.
